title: 2.13 More Colors
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Name four more colors, describe a known thing with them, and say that something is very big or very small.
grammar_function: It is + color; What color is it? It is + color; It is a + color + noun; It is a very + big/small + noun.
prerequisite: 1.10 dog, cat; 2.1 house; 2.3 bag, chair; 2.7 colors and What color is it?; 2.8 It is a + color + noun; 2.11 big, small.
speaking_outcome: Say It is brown., It is a pink bag. and It is a very big dog. about a picture.
